Your friend had always been there for you in your own celebrations and now expects you to be there in theirs, but you just don't feel up to it. Should you force yourself to go to the party for the sake of your friend's feelings, or prioritize your own comfort and stay at home?

Give a clear recommendation and explain your reasoning.
